authorization: The user reported that plugin-assistant results are unrelated to the request and expects the recommendation behavior corrected.
objective: For image-reading requests, return only semantically relevant, approved, fixed-Commit DSH plugins; never rank generic DSH/plugin words or unrelated experimental features as matches.

implementation.sharedMatcher: Use one browser-safe matcher from the server recommender and the static-page fallback. Remove DSH/plugin/filler terms, require meaningful catalog evidence, and return no plugins when no relevant match exists.
implementation.admissionBoundary: Only status=approved entries pinned to a full 40-character Commit can produce install commands. Blocked, unlisted, malformed, and unpinned entries are excluded.
implementation.imageIntent: Treat image reading/recognition as vision understanding and exclude entries whose only image capability is image generation.
implementation.catalogBoundary: No Catalog admission, recommendation ranking, metadata, model settings, API keys, or DSH Profile changes.

deterministicGates: The exact screenshot query returns the relevant approved image-reading candidates and excludes DSH Tun Proxy, DSH Plan Switch, and image-generation-only entries.
Queries containing only DSH/plugin/filler terms return no recommendations instead of popular or generic entries.
Blocked, unlisted, missing-Commit, and malformed-Commit entries never produce install commands.
The browser fallback imports the same tested matcher used by the Node API and the static build includes that module.
npm run check passes and both marketplace static builds include the shared matcher module.
Changes are committed through a CI-checked PR; production verification distinguishes static asset publication from server API deployment.
rollback: Revert only the scoped matcher, imports, browser script mode, regression tests, and plan through an audited PR. No Catalog or model configuration rollback is required.
